rule: Every material v2 decision is logged with why, evidence, losers, and reverse conditions.

entries.title: Open V2 Master Build Plan; freeze Explorer Experience 0.1 as HOLD
entries.decision: Define what v2.0 means at 100% before any Arkansas research campaign, fiscal modeling, agency redesign, tax rates, or pilots.
entries.why: v1 taught that completion requires a finish line. v2 must not confuse project growth with blueprint completion.
alternatives_rejected: Continuing Explorer expansion before V2 map freeze
entries.could_reverse_if: Plan fails orphan test or scope is shown incomplete after deliberate audit.
entries.v1_doctrine_impact: NONE — applications lane only; no silent doctrine change.

entries.title: Progress measured by resolved objects, not words written
entries.decision: V2 BLUEPRINT percent derives from object counters (baseline, functions, fiscal flows, legal pathways, households, geographies, propositions, implementation objects).
entries.why: Word-count and research volume inflated dials in earlier eras.
entries.could_reverse_if: Object taxonomy proven unfit after first gate — amend explicitly.

entries.title: UNKNOWN is a completed research result when needed evidence does not exist
entries.decision: When the evidence required for the current decision does not exist, record UNKNOWN as a completed result for that decision slot — do not endlessly research.
entries.why: Protects against three-week rabbit holes when three facts would suffice.
alternatives_rejected: Research until every box has a number
entries.could_reverse_if: Never — this is a permanent epistemic rule for v2.

entries.title: v2 may challenge applications of v1; may not silently change v1 doctrine
entries.decision: If implementation reveals a foundational proposition is defective, stop, label a potential v2.0 architectural amendment, run hostile test, and record version change.
entries.could_reverse_if: Never as a silent path — only explicit amendment process.

entries.title: Orphan / scope / completion audit PASS
entries.decision: Pass orphan test after assigning adversarial nominations (2 NEW domains: human_services, insurance_and_risk; remaining MERGE/HOME). Material orphans open = 0.
entries.why: Cannot open V2.1 until nothing important about operating Arkansas sits outside the map.
entries.could_reverse_if: A material operating surface is later shown with no HOME/MERGE path — reopen map amendment, do not silently research under wrong home.

entries.title: Freeze v2 build map
entries.decision: Freeze operating-system inventory at 38 domain homes. V2.1 OPEN_NOT_STARTED. Blueprint remains 0% until objects resolve.
entries.why: Define the entire job before attacking it in finite passes.
entries.could_reverse_if: Explicit map amendment after hostile gap — never silent domain drift.
